tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are planning a weekend getaway with your friends from the university and need to find suitable accommodation. You have found a vacation rental that looks perfect, but you want to confirm some details before booking. You need to contact the property owner, Mr. Johnson, for more information. Write an email to Mr. Johnson.
bullets: Explain why you are interested in the property.
Ask about the availability of the property for your preferred dates.
tasks.subject: Inquiry About Vacation Rental for Weekend Getaway
